notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 started with the Rust native audio workspace at commit 047d974c2dd5b5f65b51a63311fcd2ff84c46883 (2026-09-10 03:43 PKT). Initial audio-frame/queue/bypass, device catalog, deterministic device reselection and bounded stream recovery slices are implemented and CI verified. native/windows-audio is a workspace crate; EndpointSnapshot-to-DeviceCatalog mapping and explicit non-Windows unsupported behavior passed Ubuntu workspace CI in GitHub Actions run 34420328611. EnginePeriodRange and frames_for_duration now provide a verified platform-neutral model for IAudioClient3-style period constraints and target frame-count selection; GitHub Actions run 34420942799 passed rustfmt, Clippy, workspace tests and repository gates. Windows-only source contains COM/MMDevice active capture/render enumeration and Console/Multimedia/Communications default-role lookup, but that cfg(windows) branch has not yet been compiled or run on a Windows runner/hardware and is not treated as Windows runtime evidence. Actual IAudioClient3 endpoint negotiation, event-driven WASAPI capture and the virtual microphone remain pending. WU-002 is not complete until Windows capture, virtual routing, device lifecycle and latency/jitter acceptance evidence exists. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates.
